note: General Recommended Dose (GRD) with +-25% severity adjustment, per ICAR AICRP-STCR framework. Base rates below are ICAR Indian Farming (75(06), June 2025) general recommendations. Low soil-test category = GRD+25%, Medium = GRD as-is, High = GRD-25%.

Zinc Sulphate.unit: kg ZnSO4/ha (33% Zn grade) - adjust if 21% grade used, see zn_concentration_grade

Ferrous Sulphate.note: ICAR recommends foliar route for Fe, not soil kg/ha - see foliar_spec below
Ferrous Sulphate.foliar_spec: 3-4 sprays of 1.0% ferrous sulphate (FeSO4, 20% Fe) at weekly intervals

Potassium Chloride.source: ICAR, Indian Farming 75(06), June 2025 (rice GRD, medium fertile soils)
